_why_names: copyright line (company + game + trademark names; 'All rights reserved.' is set.rights); governing-law jurisdiction in the Terms (a real place name, A_r11 owns that line); a URL shown as link text; patron tier names (EGP/EDP titles, like the EGP/EDP badges); 'Commander' = the default player name stored in the save (DEFAULT_G.playerName); the rest are static placeholders in the page HTML that JS overwrites with t() text before they are seen (splashStatus via setSplashStatus, menuTitle, glSub, wallSub, waveTag, autoBtn via refreshCtrlBtns) - a data-i18n there would overwrite live text on a language switch
